digest.component_or_area: clarity-check gate and acceptance criteria detection
propositions: Two regex patterns and one scope extractor read the `## Success Criteria` heading to make clarity-check decisions, making it load-bearing and blocking store migration verification.
Code at gates.py:136 and det_floor.py:227 both key clarity bonuses on `^##\s+Success Criteria`; these two copies must remain textually in lockstep per module comments.

Test fixtures across seven files embed `## Success Criteria` headings in ticket descriptions; fixtures with both AC and SC headings must drop the SC block, and fixtures with SC as their only criteria block must be renamed to AC with bullets converted to `- [ ]` items.

Repointing the epic clarity bonus from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria (rather than dropping it) preserves the score at 6 and avoids a live regression across 108 migrated tickets in the store.
The `_SCOPE_HEADINGS` list must drop `## success criteria` and retain only `## acceptance criteria` to collapse the retired heading vocabulary.

A new contract test must assert an epic carrying `## Acceptance Criteria` and `## Context` passes both clarity-check and check-ac, with an explicit assertion that `_clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') == 6` to prove the repoint is score-neutral.
